stem: What prediction can the reader make about Hormiguita's parents based on the events that take place in scene 3?

options.label: F
options.text: Hormiguita's parents will refuse to let her leave the anthill by herself again.

options.label: G
options.text: Hormiguita's parents will be pleased with her new attitude about work.

options.label: H
options.text: Hormiguita's parents will show her how to be safer while in the forest.

options.label: J
options.text: Hormiguita's parents will allow her to have more free time to play.
